visual_requirements.description: Plain male editorial human rendering of Dumuzi, whose accepted quotation says He; bodily appearance and opaque clothing are editorial, with no claimed iconography.
Dark descent into the underworld where Dumuzi takes Inanna’s place and remains half the year; architecture is deliberately unspecified editorial stone.

prompts.A:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of TAMMUZ / DUMUZI, the Mesopotamian deity who takes Inanna’s place in the underworld.
ANATOMY: a plain adult male human editorial rendering; one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs, wearing unadorned fully opaque heavy dark woven layers. No specific appearance or clothing iconography is attested; the appearance is editorial, without sacred attributes. [tammuz-c01, tammuz-c05]
MOMENT: descending toward the viewer into the underworld, his head turned sharply downward with overwhelming determined intensity, bent torso and a forceful step; tight confrontational three-quarter upper-body crop, one empty hand held close against the rough rock wall.
POWER: no documented magical power; awe comes only from the documented underworld descent, severe intent, tight framing and strong natural light. [tammuz-c05, tammuz-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low viewpoint from the downward passage looking up into his face; normal bodily scale, no tiny humans or cosmic enlargement; head, shoulders and moving cloth nearly fill the frame, face unmistakable at 200 pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one narrow amber shaft from the surface above and behind him, sharp natural rim on cheek and cloth, deep walnut shadows, ordinary drifting stone dust.
SURFACE: rough old rock, coarse dense woven fabric and tactile human skin, energetic painterly realism.
SETTING: an unspecified steep stone passage descending into the underworld, the upper-world opening small behind his shoulder; no palace details, carvings or other characters. [tammuz-c05, tammuz-c06]
MOOD: severe, awe-inspiring and imposing, active and overwhelming, never a calm costume portrait or ordinary passer-by.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs, normal five-finger human hands; no extra limbs; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; fully opaque layered clothing, no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, weapons, crown, horns, animal transformation, magical body or invented sacred iconography.
